observation.visible_scene: A lit gas burner photographed against a pure black background. A dark elliptical silhouette of the burner head sits at the center, ringed by small blue flame tongues that appear both above the rim (as pointed tips) and below it (as rounded bases). Two faint, separate blue glows sit low at the left and right edges of the frame. The burner and its flame ring hold a fixed position and size throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: The blue flames flicker continuously, with individual tongues subtly changing height, width and shape from frame to frame (deformation, not translation).

Occasional color shifts appear at single ports: a purple/magenta tint on the right-side flames (frame 7), a small orange/red tip at the top-middle flame (frame 31), and an orange/red patch on the left-side flame (frame 34).

The overall arrangement of the flame ring, the burner silhouette, and the two lower glows remains in the same positions across all frames; no expansion, contraction, or movement of the assembly is visible.
outside_clip_unknowns: The excerpt is a mid-burn crop; whether the burner was just lit or will be extinguished is not shown.
The cause of the brief color variations (fuel/air mixture, airflow, etc.) is not observable.
uncertain_details: The two low blue glows at left and right cannot be confirmed as reflections versus separate secondary flames.
Camera motion is indeterminate because the background is uniformly black, though the stable position of the burner suggests a static viewpoint.
